title: GenAuction: A Generative Auction for Online Advertising

layout.note: A black-framed wide box titled GenAuction holds, left to right, a grey Generator region (two pale-yellow PV-Generator modules with a PV Embedding between them), Output (PVX), a pale-blue Evaluator stack, Output (PV) and a yellow VCG Payment with Output (P); three coloured dashed rows (Input, Output, Payment) sit under the frame.

lesson: Give each kind of data one dashed-outline colour and keep it on the tile columns, the arrows and the rows beneath the frame, so a long left-to-right mechanism can be followed by colour alone; show a repeated module twice with an ellipsis instead of drawing it N times.
